judgments.reason: Specification claims commission is included before payment allowing bids above coins, but the rules state a bid cannot exceed your coins and the winner pays the bid then receives a three-coin commission; the model did not articulate the claimed mechanism.

judgments.quote: don't contest P1's committed 6 on the 4-value lot.
judgments.reason: The model explicitly uses the revealed committed rival bid (P1's 6) to justify waiting and not bidding; this articulates the mechanism that seeing committed bids before you act changes your incentive to bid.
Specification asserts close settles even with unauctioned lots, but the rules state close settles after all three lots are sold; the model did not state the claimed terminal behavior.

Specification claims catalog purchases receive the auction three-coin commission, but the rules say the three-coin commission is given to auction winners and catalog items are not auction wins; the model did not articulate the proposed substitution.
